title: Combined gates worksheet
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Binary, safety and Boolean logic
source: Seeded from computing/y8 lesson 8 (Combined gates worksheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 8: Combining gates; logic quiz. To understand how logic gates combine into circuits and how to work out their output

model.title: Q = (A AND B) OR C. Find Q when A = 1, B = 0, C = 1.

questions.q: Q = NOT A AND B. Find Q for A = 0, B = 1.
questions.model: Teacher: NOT applies to A only: NOT 0 = 1; then AND with B (1) gives 1.

questions.q: Write the expression for: 'the light is on if switch A is on and switch B is off'.
Core: Complete the truth table for Q = NOT (A AND B) (4 rows) on the worksheet.
questions.model: Teacher completes row 00: A AND B = 0, NOT 0 = 1.

questions.q: Extend: Build Q = (A AND B) OR C in CircuitVerse and check two rows of the slide table.
questions.a: Lights match the table rows tested.

questions.q: Logic quiz (portal, 10 questions): binary conversions, Boolean expressions, gate truth tables and a combined circuit.
Big question: how many gates for 'code correct AND NOT night', and which?
